scene.label: Act 1, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. A field before Thebes.

content.text: Cornets. A battle struck within; then a retreat. Flourish. Then enter, Theseus, as victor, with a Herald, other Lords, and Soldiers. The three Queens meet him and fall on their faces before him.

lines.text: To thee no star be dark!
lines.plainText: To thee no star be dark

lines.text: Both heaven and earth
lines.plainText: Both heaven and earth

lines.text: Friend thee for ever!
lines.plainText: Friend thee for ever

lines.text: All the good that may
lines.plainText: All the good that may

lines.text: Be wished upon thy head, I cry "Amen" to 't!
lines.plainText: Be wished upon thy head I cry Amen to 't

lines.text: Th' impartial gods, who from the mounted heavens
lines.plainText: Th' impartial gods who from the mounted heavens

lines.text: View us their mortal herd, behold who err
lines.plainText: View us their mortal herd behold who err

lines.text: And, in their time, chastise. Go and find out
lines.plainText: And in their time chastise Go and find out

lines.text: The bones of your dead lords and honour them
lines.plainText: The bones of your dead lords and honour them

lines.text: With treble ceremony, rather than a gap
lines.plainText: With treble ceremony rather than a gap

lines.text: Should be in their dear rites, we would supply 't,
lines.plainText: Should be in their dear rites we would supply 't

lines.text: But those we will depute which shall invest
lines.plainText: But those we will depute which shall invest

lines.text: You in your dignities and even each thing
lines.plainText: You in your dignities and even each thing

lines.text: Our haste does leave imperfect. So, adieu,
lines.plainText: Our haste does leave imperfect So adieu

lines.text: And heaven's good eyes look on you.
lines.plainText: And heaven's good eyes look on you

content.text: Enter a Herald and Soldiers bearing Palamon and Arcite on hearses.

lines.text: Men of great quality, as may be judged
lines.plainText: Men of great quality as may be judged

lines.text: By their appointment. Some of Thebes have told 's
lines.plainText: By their appointment Some of Thebes have told 's

lines.text: They are sisters' children, nephews to the King.
lines.plainText: They are sisters' children nephews to the King

lines.text: By th' helm of Mars, I saw them in the war,
lines.plainText: By th' helm of Mars I saw them in the war

lines.text: Like to a pair of lions, smeared with prey,
lines.plainText: Like to a pair of lions smeared with prey

lines.text: Make lanes in troops aghast. I fixed my note
lines.plainText: Make lanes in troops aghast I fixed my note

lines.text: Constantly on them, for they were a mark
lines.plainText: Constantly on them for they were a mark

lines.text: Worth a god's view. What prisoner was 't that told me
lines.plainText: Worth a god's view What prisoner was 't that told me

lines.text: When I enquired their names?
lines.plainText: When I enquired their names

lines.text: Wi' leave, they're called Arcite and Palamon.
lines.plainText: Wi' leave they're called Arcite and Palamon

lines.text: 'Tis right; those, those. They are not dead?
lines.plainText: 'Tis right those those They are not dead

lines.text: Nor in a state of life. Had they been taken
lines.plainText: Nor in a state of life Had they been taken

lines.text: When their last hurts were given, 'twas possible
lines.plainText: When their last hurts were given 'twas possible

lines.text: They might have been recovered; yet they breathe
lines.plainText: They might have been recovered yet they breathe

lines.text: And have the name of men.
lines.plainText: And have the name of men

lines.text: Then like men use 'em.
lines.plainText: Then like men use 'em

lines.text: The very lees of such, millions of rates,
lines.plainText: The very lees of such millions of rates

lines.text: Exceed the wine of others. All our surgeons
lines.plainText: Exceed the wine of others All our surgeons

lines.text: Convent in their behoof; our richest balms,
lines.plainText: Convent in their behoof our richest balms

lines.text: Rather than niggard, waste. Their lives concern us
lines.plainText: Rather than niggard waste Their lives concern us

lines.text: Much more than Thebes is worth. Rather than have 'em
lines.plainText: Much more than Thebes is worth Rather than have 'em

lines.text: Freed of this plight, and in their morning state,
lines.plainText: Freed of this plight and in their morning state

lines.text: Sound and at liberty, I would 'em dead;
lines.plainText: Sound and at liberty I would 'em dead

lines.text: But forty-thousandfold we had rather have 'em
lines.plainText: But fortythousandfold we had rather have 'em

lines.text: Prisoners to us than death. Bear 'em speedily
lines.plainText: Prisoners to us than death Bear 'em speedily

lines.text: From our kind air, to them unkind, and minister
lines.plainText: From our kind air to them unkind and minister

lines.text: What man to man may do, for our sake, more,
lines.plainText: What man to man may do for our sake more

lines.text: Since I have known frights, fury, friends' behests,
lines.plainText: Since I have known frights fury friends' behests

lines.text: Love's provocations, zeal, a mistress' task,
lines.plainText: Love's provocations zeal a mistress' task

lines.text: Desire of liberty, a fever, madness,
lines.plainText: Desire of liberty a fever madness

lines.text: Hath set a mark which nature could not reach to
lines.plainText: Hath set a mark which nature could not reach to

lines.text: Without some imposition, sickness in will
lines.plainText: Without some imposition sickness in will

lines.text: O'er-wrestling strength in reason. For our love
lines.plainText: O'erwrestling strength in reason For our love

lines.text: And great Apollo's mercy, all our best
lines.plainText: And great Apollo's mercy all our best

lines.text: Their best skill tender. Lead into the city,
lines.plainText: Their best skill tender Lead into the city

lines.text: Where, having bound things scattered, we will post
lines.plainText: Where having bound things scattered we will post

lines.text: To Athens 'fore our army.
lines.plainText: To Athens 'fore our army
